content:
Get on the fast lane,
汽车是旅行的工具
is the first installment in Banner Highway, a browser-based visual
poetry series reimagining classic Burma-Shave roadside
advertisement-poems for the Information Superhighway. The banners
come from Banner Depot 2000, a web-based archive of
1990s–early 2000s banner ads (banner-depot-2000.net).

By
Switcheristic Telecommunications
:
Richard Lewei Huang
&
Yufeng Zhao. Logo design by
Kay Zeng.
